value.rationale: Two canonical exact invariants classify the entire family of ordered-Bell coefficient sequences modulo every m, not merely one evaluation or one fixed Stirling column. The full-period obstruction differs structurally between odd p and p=2, and the sharp transient has a uniform and nontrivial single-coefficient witness. This disambiguates general polynomial congruences from shorter scalar periods, a meaningful natural classification rather than a numerical instance.
